prephysics_gates: New explicit authorization is required; do not infer extension from old metadata.

execution_if_separately_authorized.trace_capture: Full direct tick receipts and root-inclusive path guards; preforce and returned states kept separate. Stop before a write would exceed cap.
execution_if_separately_authorized.cleanup: Close every world on success/error; require body/joint and live-world zero. All gates and teardown fit total caps.

comparison.horizon: Six own holds per arm; equal raw elapsed time, common prefix if an arm terminates. No extrapolation after termination.
comparison.primary: Canonical unwrapped progress difference at equal elapsed time, with root-inclusive minimum safety margin; no seed averaging over repeat copies.
mechanism_secondary: Time-aligned front lateral/longitudinal force, force clipping, body lateral velocity, path-normal velocity, signed error and heading.
End-hold joint tracking and actual steering increments. Maxima at different ticks/wheels must not be vector-summed.
comparison.local_support: Both cold repeats and held first exactly reproduce under the registered signature; variant completes H6 safely; variant progress >= control +0.25m at equal time; variant minimum margin >= control -0.25m. This supports a local progress/safety tradeoff only, never deployment.
comparison.falsification: Technical gates pass and variant becomes unsafe earlier, or loses >=0.25m progress without >=0.25m minimum-margin compensation. Reject only this filter-removal intervention at this fixture.
comparison.other: TECHNICAL_STOP for failed gates/caps, otherwise NO_INFORMATION including mixed tradeoffs, root domination, or effects below thresholds. No automatic follow-up.
comparison.eleven_second_gate: Any future promotion would separately need preregistered natural-trigger DEV evaluation and actual complete-lap improvement toward11s, then untouched HOLDOUT/SEALED. No short-margin result satisfies that gate.
